_procedure: Convenience sample of recent LLM-driven trading pipelines for which a machine-readable full text (arXiv HTML) could be retrieved on 2026-07-31. Each paper was queried for five items; an item is coded 'yes' only when a verbatim sentence stating it was located, otherwise 'no'. Single coder, keyword-guided retrieval over the HTML full text. This is illustrative of reporting practice, not a systematic review, and it is described that way in the paper.

_items.prompt_text: the exact prompt text appears in the paper
_items.holding: the holding period or rebalancing frequency is stated
_items.entry_timing: the timing of trade entry relative to information arrival is stated
_items.pipeline_sensitivity: a sensitivity or robustness analysis over pipeline implementation choices (prompt variants, thresholds, holding period, weighting, parsing) is reported
_items.costs: transaction costs are modelled, with the level stated

evidence._note: no machine-readable HTML full text available; excluded from the coded sample

evidence.pipeline_sensitivity: ablation of within-episode CVaR risk control and over-episode belief update
